Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Vihaan - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Siya - 11 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
3. Neeta - 39 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Vihaan stands in the park. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "Vihaan, what's the plan today?"

[Vihaan throws the ball to Mother.]

Neeta: "Hmm, I see."

[Vihaan kicks the football hard.]

Vihaan: "Mom, listen!"

[Vihaan goes down the slide.]

Vihaan (happily): "What next?"

[Vihaan plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Neeta (surprised): "What next?"

[Vihaan feeds the birds.]

Vihaan (laughing): "Hmm, I see."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Neeta: "Vihaan, look over here."

[Vihaan walks across the courtyard.]

Neeta: "Yes, of course."

[Vihaan tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Vihaan (surprised): "I'm ready!"

[Vihaan hides behind the tree.]

Vihaan (gently): "Oh wow!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Vihaan stands in the living room. Siya and Neeta stand near him.]

Vihaan: "What a nice place."

[Vihaan combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Vihaan: "Okay, Siya."

[Siya applies kajal to her eyes.]

Neeta: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Siya puts on red lipstick.]

Siya (gently): "That was such a fun day!"
